summary: A new initiative by PRX and Jenna Weiss-Berman, co-chair of Pineapple Street Media, along with Amit Dashi, a serial entrepreneur launching IVM podcasts for spoken word content in India, will fund and mentor 12 teams with seed funding, training, and mentorship. The advisory committee for this program includes Jenna Weiss-Berman and Amit Dashi, and applicants are encouraged to apply via the PRX website. The host also promotes the #PodsInColor hashtag, noting its widespread use across social media platforms to build community among podcasts of color.
